AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#700 @ 5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb — VERDICT: APPROVE
A/B/C = 0/0/1

Independent T4 follow-up: AUD-SOL-PV3-118, agent 118; complete 31-file diff and relevant failure/logging call paths reviewed, with no candidate implementation edit; size is 2,012 changed lines: 603 source, 1,367 tests and 42 docs, below the hard cap and covered by the operator's KEEP assessment. [Reviewed comparison](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/compare/2af682ca968f11210971abdec8f9d9060cac609f...5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb), [SIZE ASSESSMENT KEEP](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/700#issuecomment-5982938661)

## Prior A/B disposition: all closed

**Sol B-700-1 / Opus C-700-3: CLOSED.** `log-pii.ts:137-227` and its email/digest/checkout consumers replace regex-preserved free text with bounded status, known codes and code-owned error classes; provider error bodies and render exception messages no longer survive in emitted diagnostics, `EmailSendLog.error`, returned email errors or digest failure rows, and the name/free-text, malformed-body and old truncation-boundary probes all pass. [Failure helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/src/observability/log-pii.ts#L137-L227), [email consumers](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/src/email/email.service.ts), [independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37223666802)

**Sol B-700-2 / Opus C-700-5: CLOSED.** `scheduling-webhook.controller.ts:98-140` logs only recognized finite event/key labels and numeric unknown-key counts; crafted private names become `event=other`, not token-shaped echoes, while both no-op acknowledgments and recognized-event controls remain intact. [Finite-label implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/src/scheduling/scheduling-webhook.controller.ts#L98-L140), [both-handler replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37223666802)

**Opus B-700-1: CLOSED.** `coach-brief.service.ts:1453-1512,1570-1575,1808,1836-1858` passes the coach ID into the production call and emits ID/mode/date plus sanitized failure descriptions, never the coach's full name or SDK exception message; both original coach-name assertions and stronger permanent controls pass. [Coach brief source](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/src/coach/brief/coach-brief.service.ts), [replay run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37223666802)

**Opus B-700-2 / prior Sol C-700-1: CLOSED.** Supabase generateLink/reset errors now emit class/status/known-code diagnostics, and every finance request method supplies a fixed route label instead of its encoded-address/search URL; the old reset-email and encoded-finance-path probes pass unchanged. [Auth source](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/src/auth/auth.service.ts), [finance route labels](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/src/admin/federation/finance-admin.client.ts#L33-L183), [independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37223666802)

## Guard and remaining C

The guard catches the prior camelCase coach-name, Supabase `.message` and encoded-address-path shapes; current scanner output matches exactly **306 legacy exception-text calls in 141 named files**, with none permitted in the listed fixed modules. [Guard implementation and pins](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/test/privacy/no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts#L407-L754), [exact-candidate replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37223666802)

Independent negative controls exercised the real scanner against an added legacy-file error site and confirmed that both increased counts and decreased-but-not-repinned counts fail the equality constraint: **2 suites / 30 tests pass**, including the three additional negative controls. [Negative-control run 37223961479](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37223961479)

**C-700-2 — inherited optional follow-up, outside the corrected surfaces:** `test/privacy/no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts:506-648,712-734` enumerates remaining legacy exception-text log calls, including unchanged account-deletion/provider-worker code; this is a bounded count ratchet, not proof that the whole repository is PII-free. Fix rule: normalize those calls to `describeFailure` in a separate mechanical PR, lowering each corresponding pin, never adding/increasing pins or transferring exemptions; baseline edits remain independently reviewed T4 gate changes rather than self-authorized growth. [Explicit legacy baseline](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/test/privacy/no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts#L499-L648), [operator's separate-PR decision](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/700#issuecomment-5982938661)

## Apple wording and rollout truth

The new shared policy/help sentence and mobile #368 give the same iOS 18+ Settings route and earlier-iOS/other-device web route; rendered-page tests pass and current official Apple instructions agree. [Shared backend copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts#L95-L98), [mobile counterpart](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/fdfecc47a4ff8a65bf1cd8f6a26f1c2a34c88c45/src/screens/settings/DeleteAccountScreen.tsx#L95-L115), [Apple Support 102571](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102571), [iOS 18 guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/sign-in-with-apple-iph238921d37/18.0/ios/18.0)

Fresh public-page reads still show the previous unqualified iPhone sentence on live `/privacy` and `/help/delete-account`; recommended operator default is prompt paired merge after dual approval/green, then #700 deployment and public-copy verification before mobile release, not a claim that this candidate is already published. [Live Privacy Policy](https://app.trygrowthproject.com/privacy), [live deletion help](https://app.trygrowthproject.com/help/delete-account)

## CI and G09 applicability

Required checks are **11/11 green** at this exact candidate SHA, with matching GitHub Actions check identity; full build executed **731 passing suites / 12,592 passing tests**, with 23 skipped suites, 241 skipped tests and 5 todo separately disclosed. [Exact-head build](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37222341084/job/111495055067), [head checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/700/checks)

The deploy-readiness release gate is skipped and is not counted as a passed release gate. [Skipped readiness gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37222341071/job/111495055727)

The builder's test-only predecessor and real before/after logs were independently checked: **43 failed / 21 passed** before and **388 passed / 16 skipped** after; both original lenses' four probe specs were additionally copied byte-identically and replayed over this exact candidate, yielding **9 suites / 64 passing tests**. [Builder before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221266107), [builder after](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37222059865), [independent exact-candidate replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37223666802)

No earlier #700 approval exists or is reused; every candidate change was reviewed directly, while unchanged original #611 deletion/runtime routing/Sentry/logger inputs were compared byte-for-byte and only that unaffected evidence remains applicable. [Prior Sol #611 evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611#issuecomment-5976633102), [current candidate diff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/compare/2af682ca968f11210971abdec8f9d9060cac609f...5e3dabb0d0b9adc3ecf53c06f7bccf11852745fb)

This is source/test approval, not a vendor-deletion, production-secret or installed-device attestation; excluded migration-dependent owner notes, calorie values and legal-page voice remain operator follow-ups. [Builder follow-up disclosure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/700#issuecomment-5982863868)
